messages:
alex (sales): FYI Apex Systems POC is getting 429s during a big embeddings import (S3 -> /v1/embeddings). they run 8 uploader pods. customer wants a demo-safe fix + billing clarity. tagging @cleo and @priya.

cleo (eng): thanks. do we have a failing request id or an alert id? my hunch: per-route concurrency cap + burst window.

alex (sales): alert id ALRT-9400, sample req req_ab12ef (09:12 UTC). they batch ~500 docs per request.

quota-bot: Rate cap triggered - tenant=apex-prod - route=/v1/embeddings - cap_type=per_route_concurrency - limit=24 - observed=41

priya (eng-sre): confirmed the cap. mitigation choices: 1) temporary override for 2h 2) ask client to reduce concurrency/batch size 3) enable client-side throttling/backoff. we can push a one-off paid uplift.

sam (solutions): for demos we usually do a 2-hour uplift and recommend Dedicated if they repeat imports. include note about token billing on retries.

cleo (eng): quick check - retries are billed per successful token. if their uploader retries failed requests, tokens count again unless they dedupe with an idempotency key. recommend adding an idempotency header.

alex (sales): customer asked: will raising limit affect other tenants?

priya (eng-sre): override is tenant-scoped; no cross-tenant impact. I can apply override: `POST /internal/quotas/override {"tenant":"apex-prod","route":"/v1/embeddings","concurrency_limit":80,"duration_secs":7200}` upon sales OK.

alex (sales): sales OK — Apex will cover demo uplift. please proceed. also they sent a security checklist, asking about data at rest and access to logs.

audit-bot: New security questionnaire submitted by tenant apex-prod - form_id=sec-q-772 - required fields: ip_whitelist, data_retention, kms_info

sam (solutions): kevin from security can answer KMS and retention. include the IP whitelist link and we'll reply in ~24h.

priya (eng-sre): override applied (ov-id=temp-9400). enabling elevated logs for 30m and watching error rate.

quota-bot: Override applied - override_id=temp-9400 - tenant=apex-prod - new_limit=80 - expires_in=7200s

cleo (eng): logs show 429s dropped immediately after override. recommend client resume at lowered concurrency (3 pods) and keep idempotency.

alex (sales): relaying to Apex: resume upload at 3 pods and we'll monitor. thanks team.

priya (eng-sre): monitoring green for 20m. will auto-revert override after expiry and follow up if needed.

alex (sales): closing loop with customer and prepping a quote for Dedicated if they plan ongoing large imports. :white_check_mark:
__notes: Synthetic Slack thread for POC rate-limit troubleshooting and presales coordination (per-route concurrency, temporary override, billing and security questionnaire). No title field per agents.md.
